import sys

inf = int(1e6)
DP = None
number = ""

def get(index, pos, neg, carry):
    global DP, number
    truCarry = carry - 50
    if index == 17:
        if pos + neg + truCarry == 0:
            return 0
        else:
            return inf
    if DP[index][pos][neg][carry] != -1:
        return DP[index][pos][neg][carry]
    res = inf
    for p in range(0, min(15, pos) + 1):
        for n in range(0, min(15, neg) + 1):
            sum_val = pos - neg + truCarry
            currentBit = (sum_val % 10 + 10) % 10
            nextCarry = (sum_val // 10) if sum_val > 0 else ((sum_val - 9) // 10)
            if currentBit != int(number[index]):
                continue
            res = min(res,
                      get(index + 1, pos - p, neg - n, nextCarry + 50) + (p + n) * (index + 1))
    DP[index][pos][neg][carry] = res
    return res

def main():
    global DP, number
    n = int(sys.stdin.read().strip())
    size = 50
    DP = [[[[-1 for _ in range(100)] for _ in range(size)] for _ in range(size)] for _ in range(20)]
    number_str = str(n)
    while len(number_str) < 17:
        number_str = "0" + number_str
    number = number_str[::-1]
    result = inf
    for pos in range(size):
        for neg in range(size):
            result = min(result, get(0, pos, neg, 50))
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
